# Apps you can read as worked examples

These already run on the hardware, under the same constraints you have:
shapes and text, no sprite sheets, no sound files. Open one with
`vupp reference show <slug> --json`.

| slug | title | category | lines | palette |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `abc-trace` | ABC Trace | learning | 595 | built-in 16 |
| `asteroids` | Space Pop | game | 406 | built-in 16 |
| `beat-bop` | Beat Bop | music | 416 | built-in 16 |
| `drift` | Drift | creative | 324 | 16 colours |
| `fish-count` | Fish Count | learning | 442 | 16 colours |
| `maze` | Maze | game | 609 | built-in 16 |
| `music-maker` | Music Maker | music | 468 | built-in 16 |
| `ripple` | Ripple | creative | 411 | 16 colours |
| `runner` | Dash | game | 632 | built-in 16 |
| `spelling` | Spelling | learning | 877 | built-in 16 |
| `tetris` | Blocks! | game | 493 | built-in 16 |

- **abc-trace** — tracks abc.letter, abc.alphabet; uses the touchscreen
- **asteroids** — tracks space.pops, space.golden
- **beat-bop** — tracks beat.streak, beat.tier; uses the touchscreen
- **drift** — tracks calm.sleep, calm.session; uses the touchscreen
- **fish-count** — tracks math.round; uses the touchscreen
- **maze** — tracks maze.level_done, maze.all_done
- **music-maker** — tracks music.session, music.tune_saved, music.song_done; uses the touchscreen
- **ripple** — tracks calm.quiet_time; uses the touchscreen
- **runner** — tracks dash.finished, dash.all_levels
- **spelling** — tracks spelling.word, spelling.tier_up; uses the touchscreen
- **tetris** — tracks blocks.cleared, blocks.milestone, blocks.best
